name: Zamek's Distraction
summary: In Thousand Needles, Zamek's Distraction can draw Rizzle away while you work through Keeping Pace. You cannot finish Keeping Pace without it.

sections.title: A Timely Diversion
sections.body: While you work through Keeping Pace, Zamek draws Rizzle from his hut. The Indurium plans remain behind.

aliases: where do i get zameks distraction
faq.answer: Zamek gives it in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: How does this relate to Keeping Pace?
aliases: is this needed for keeping pace
faq.answer: It comes while you are in the middle of Keeping Pace, and you cannot finish that step without it.
Rizzle leaves his hut, and his plans are left behind.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde adventurers work with Zamek?
faq.answer: Yes. Zamek is neutral and works with either faction.
